backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the QuickCricket backend, defining core data types (Match, Innings, Ball, Player, etc.) and functions for user profiles, player stats, match management, and live scoring with access control via a MixinAuthorization pattern.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking the Statistics section fix (routes, MatchStatsPage, PlayerStatsPage) to relevant source files, components, and test IDs with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a reference for build planning and code navigation.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the QuickCricket Scorer Vite app, mounting the React app into a root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (dashboard, match setup, live scoring, innings/match summary, stats, teams, player stats) and wraps the app in QueryClientProvider, ThemeProvider, and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AppErrorBoundary: React class-based error boundary that catches unhandled render errors, displays a user-friendly error card with the error message, and provides a reset button that redirects to the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Application header component providing cricket branding, navigation buttons (Home, Teams, Player Stats), connectivity status display, and Internet Identity login/logout with timeout detection and toast-based error handling.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper that renders AppHeader, a responsive centered main content area, and a footer with a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/BackendCanisterI: A dialog component that explains what a backend canister is, how offline mode works, and what 'Backend unavailable' means, triggered by an info button or custom children.
frontend/src/components/ConnectivityStat: Displays a connectivity badge (Online/Offline) with reason text using the useConnectivity hook, alongside a BackendCanisterInfoDialog button.
frontend/src/components/DeleteMatchConfi: An alert dialog that confirms match deletion, showing context-aware warnings about whether the match will also be deleted from the backend canister.
frontend/src/components/live/BallByBallR: A dialog that displays a scrollable ball-by-ball breakdown for a specific over, showing batsman, bowler, and outcome for each ball.
frontend/src/components/live/BatterRoleS: A labeled select component for choosing a batter from a player list, with diagnostic logging and error/empty-state messaging.
frontend/src/components/live/NextBatterD: A dialog for selecting the next batter after a wicket, handling the all-out case by showing an informational message instead of a selector.
frontend/src/components/live/NextBowlerD: A dialog for selecting the next bowler at the end of an over, with a warning prompt if no bowler has been selected yet.
frontend/src/components/live/OverByOverB: Renders a grid of clickable over-summary cards showing runs per over, opening a BallByBallReportDialog when an over is selected.
frontend/src/components/mobile/MobileSaf: A wrapper around DialogContent that constrains height to 90vh and enables internal scrolling for safe display on mobile devices.
A wrapper around SelectContent that limits dropdown height to 60vh with overflow scrolling for mobile-friendly select menus.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: A modal dialog for first-time users to enter their name and create a profile, using the useSaveCallerUserProfile mutation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated identities, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useConnectivity.ts: Monitors device network status and backend availability via periodic probes, exposing online/offline state with a typed reason (network-down or backend-unavailable).
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context with login/logout functionality, persisting identity across page reloads via AuthClient and exposing login status states.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalMatchIntegrit: Checks local match storage integrity by counting total, loadable, and corrupted matches, with a retryable effect and loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for backend data operations (user profiles, matches, teams, innings, etc.) with offline-first local storage fallback and mutation side effects.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollIntoViewOnFo: Scrolls a referenced element into view when it receives focus, with a short delay to accommodate mobile keyboard appearance.
frontend/src/hooks/useUnsavedOfflineChan: Warns users before leaving a page when there are unsynced offline changes by attaching a beforeunload handler and providing a confirmNavigation helper.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining light and dark mode CSS custom properties for the design system (colors, radius, sidebar, charts) and basic mobile layout rules.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/offline/localMatchStore.ts: Provides localStorage-based CRUD operations for cricket matches with serialization/deserialization, local ID generation, and a recordBall method that updates innings state offline.
Provides structured error logging and user-facing error message generation for offline cricket match operations such as saving, loading, and deleting matches.
frontend/src/offline/playerStatsStore.ts: Manages a localStorage cache for cumulative player statistics, with functions to load, save, retrieve individual player stats, and clear the cache.
frontend/src/offline/serialization.ts: Provides BigInt-safe JSON serialization and deserialization helpers for converting backend Match, Innings, Ball, Team, and Player types to/from browser storage-compatible formats.
frontend/src/offline/teamRosterStore.ts: Manages persistent team roster storage in localStorage, supporting CRUD operations (save, get, update, delete) with BigInt-safe serialization for Team objects.
frontend/src/pages/InningsSummaryPage.ts: Displays a post-innings summary page showing batting and bowling statistics for the last innings of a match, with offline support via localMatchStore.
frontend/src/pages/LiveScoringPage.tsx: Implements the live cricket scoring interface, managing ball-by-ball input, batter/bowler selection dialogs, undo functionality, and innings state with offline persistence.
The main dashboard listing all cricket matches with options to navigate to a match, create a new one, or delete one via a confirmation dialog. Also shows connectivity status and alerts for any corrupted local matches.
frontend/src/pages/MatchSetupPage.tsx: A form page for creating a new cricket match, allowing users to configure two teams (with players loaded from saved rosters or entered manually), overs per innings, and toss details. Supports both authenticated/online and offline/local-only match creation.
frontend/src/pages/MatchStatsPage.tsx: Displays per-innings batting and bowling statistics tables for a specific match loaded from local storage. Uses tabbed navigation to switch between innings and computes stats via utility functions.
frontend/src/pages/MatchSummaryPage.tsx: Shows a completed match summary including scores, toss info, result sentence, and per-innings batting/bowling breakdowns in tabbed tables. Fetches match data via a query hook and validates the match ID before rendering.
frontend/src/pages/PlayerStatsPage.tsx: Displays cumulative batting and bowling statistics for a selected player, filtered by team, computed across all locally stored matches. Includes empty-state handling and dropdown selectors for team and player.
frontend/src/pages/TeamsPlayersPage.tsx: A React page for managing saved team rosters, allowing users to create, edit, and delete teams with player name lists via dialogs and toast notifications.
frontend/src/utils/backendAuthErrors.ts: Utility functions to detect and normalize backend authorization errors into user-friendly messages, with a specific helper for match creation auth errors.
frontend/src/utils/ballByBallReport.ts: Utility functions to retrieve balls for a specific over, format individual ball outcomes as display strings, and convert ball arrays into a display-friendly format.
frontend/src/utils/chase.ts: Utility functions for computing chase-related match statistics including target runs, remaining runs, wickets remaining, and a human-readable match result sentence.
frontend/src/utils/cumulativePlayerStats: Computes cumulative batting and bowling statistics for a named player across multiple matches, returning formatted averages, strike rates, and economy rates.
frontend/src/utils/ensureMatchInitialize: Ensures a match has at least one innings initialized based on toss decision, creating the first innings with correct batting/bowling team assignments if none exists.
frontend/src/utils/formatTossInfo.ts: Formats a match's toss information into a human-readable sentence indicating which team won the toss and their decision to bat or bowl.
frontend/src/utils/inningsCompletion.ts: Utility functions to count legal deliveries, check if an innings is complete based on an overs limit, and compute current overs and balls from ball history.
frontend/src/utils/inningsEligibility.ts: Utility functions to determine which batters are eligible for selection by filtering out dismissed players and optionally excluding a specific player.
frontend/src/utils/lastOver.ts: Computes a view model for the last over by selecting the most recent 6 legal deliveries and formatting each ball into a compact display token with labels and wicket flags.
frontend/src/utils/matchStats.ts: Provides functions to compute per-player batting and bowling statistics (runs, balls faced, strike rate, wickets, economy, etc.) from an innings object. Exports typed row interfaces for both batting and bowling stat tables.
frontend/src/utils/overByOverBreakdown.t: Computes a runs-per-over breakdown from a ball history array, grouping every 6 legal deliveries into a completed over entry. Returns only fully completed overs.
frontend/src/utils/parseMatchId.ts: Parses a match ID string into a BigInt, returning a discriminated union result indicating success or a descriptive error message. Validates that the value is present and non-negative.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routing, persisting values to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive parameters from the URL hash without page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode support, custom OKLCH-based design tokens (colors, border radius, shadows), accordion keyframe animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks the current project state (version 9) for a cricket scoring app, listing known issues, existing feature fix requests (routing, stats loading, UI cleanup), and pending new feature requests like player selection during a match.
